Header.SaveBlocked: Cannot save until errors are fixed

Message.ChangesKept: Not saved. Your changes remain in the designer.
Message.ChangesDiscarded: Not saved. Your changes were discarded.
Message.ReadOnly: You do not have permission to edit this artifact. Ask its owner for edit access, then use Recheck access.
Message.ReadOnlyPublished: This artifact is published, so it is read only. Create a draft in Workspace if you'd like to edit a new version of it.
Message.ReadOnlyFolder: You do not have permission to create an artifact in this folder. Ask its owner for access, then use Recheck access.
Message.ConfirmDiscard: Discard your unsaved changes and return to Workspace?
Message.ConfirmReload: Discard your unsaved changes and reload the latest artifact?
Message.SavedWithChanges: Saved. Further changes remain in the designer.
Message.SavedNewIdentity: Saved as a new artifact. Further changes remain here; reload the saved artifact before saving again.
Message.SavedReloadRequired: Saved. Reload the designer before saving again.
Message.SaveConfirmed: The stored version matches your submitted changes. Your current edits have been kept.
Message.SaveUnchanged: The stored version is unchanged. You can retry Save.
Message.AccessRestored: Access is restored and the stored version is unchanged. Your edits have been kept; you can save again.

Version.Title: Create a new template version?
Version.Explanation: The existing template will be published and your changes saved as a new draft. Existing metadata stays with the original template.
Version.ExplanationOfVersion: The existing template will be published as version {{version}} and your changes saved as a new draft. Existing metadata stays with the original template.
Version.InstancesOne: 1 metadata instance uses this template. These changes require a new version.
Version.InstancesOfVersionOne: 1 metadata instance uses this template (version {{version}} draft). These changes require a new version.
Version.Instances: {{count}} metadata instances use this template. These changes require a new version.
Version.InstancesOfVersion: {{count}} metadata instances use this template (version {{version}} draft). These changes require a new version.
Version.ExistingInstances: Existing metadata instances use this template. These changes require a new version.
Version.ExistingInstancesOfVersion: Existing metadata instances use this template (version {{version}} draft). These changes require a new version.

Error.UnknownRoute: Unknown designer route. Open a template, element or field from Workspace.
Error.InvalidWorkspaceUrl: Invalid Workspace URL in frontend configuration.
Error.Conflict: This artifact changed since you opened it. Your edits have been kept; reopen the latest version before saving.
Error.SessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again before saving.
Error.Forbidden: You do not have permission to save this artifact.
Error.VersioningOnlyByOwner: Only the template's owner can create a new version. Your edits have been kept.
Error.ChooseReusable: Choose a reusable field or element.

NameRequired.template: Enter a template name before saving.
NameRequired.element: Enter an element name before saving.
NameRequired.field: Enter a field name before saving.

Error.NoFolder: No destination folder is available. Open Create from a Workspace folder.
Error.NoValidator: The server did not provide a version validator. Reopen this artifact before saving.
Error.SavedVerificationUnavailable: Saved, but the server did not provide a version validator. Your current edits remain in Designer. Use Check save status before saving again.
Error.ComponentLoad: Could not load {{name}}. Rebuild and stage the local components.
Error.ConfigurationLoad: Frontend configuration could not be loaded.
Error.SignIn: Sign-in could not be initialized. Reload to try again.
Error.MissingFieldDesigner: This Designer bundle does not include CEFD. Stage a current CED bundle and reload.
Error.OutdatedBundle: The local CED bundle is out of date. Rebuild CED and restart Designer.
Error.InvalidChildren: The repository returned an incomplete child list. Please retry.
Error.InvalidImpact: The server did not provide a valid update assessment. Your changes have been kept.
Error.InvalidValidation: The server did not provide a complete validation report.
Error.ValidationFailed: The document did not pass server validation.
Error.DocumentChanged: The document changed while saving was being prepared. Review it and save again.
Error.InvalidArtifact: The repository returned a different or incomplete artifact. Reload to try again.
Error.SaveUnconfirmed: We could not confirm whether your changes were saved. Your changes remain in the designer. Use Check save status to find out before saving again.
Error.Unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
Error.Unreadable: CEDAR cannot read this artifact, so it cannot be opened. {{detail}}
Error.SessionEnded: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
Error.ForbiddenOpen: You do not have permission to open this artifact.
Error.ForbiddenCreate: You do not have permission to create an artifact here.
Error.UnreadableAnswer: The server sent an answer the Designer cannot read. Reload to try again.
Error.ManifestLoad: The component manifest could not be loaded. Rebuild and stage the local components.
Error.RecoveryReadOnly: You do not currently have permission to update this artifact. Your edits have been kept; saving remains blocked.
Error.RecoveryUnresolved: The stored version could not be reconciled with your save. Your edits have been kept; saving remains blocked.
Error.RecoveryUnavailable: Save status could not be checked. Your edits have been kept. Check your connection and access, then try again.
Error.AccessUnavailable: Access could not be checked. Your edits have been kept. Sign in or check your connection, then try again.
Error.ReusableUnconfirmed: The reusable artifact could not be confirmed. Your changes are kept. Retry this action to check the same saved identity.
Error.ValidationTimedOut: Validation did not finish in time. Try saving again.

Draft.StorageError: This browser could not retain the draft. Keep this page open to avoid losing your changes.
Draft.Offer: Unfinished work from this tab is available. Restore it or discard it before saving.
Draft.RestoredGuarded: Your draft has been restored. Use Check save status or Recheck access before saving again.
Draft.Invalid: This retained draft cannot be restored here. Use the same account, deployment and artifact.
Draft.UnknownCreate: The previous create or version operation is unresolved. Restore the draft and use Check save status before discarding it.
